# Japan Luggage Check

> Free, unofficial Japan suitcase checker and keyless JSON API. (1) Shinkansen luggage rule by line: on the Tokaido, Sanyo, Kyushu and Nishi-Kyushu Shinkansen a bag with length + width + height of 161–250 cm needs a reserved oversized-baggage seat (free; ¥1,000 fee if unreserved); over 250 cm / 30 kg not allowed; JR East-area lines have no reservation. (2) Yamato TA-Q-BIN luggage forwarding price between any two of Japan's 47 prefectures, or to an airport (Airport TA-Q-BIN, +¥660, send 2 days before the flight), from Yamato's current Japanese cash and cashless tables (revised 2025-10-01). Yamato's own English rate page and some travel sites still show pre-October-2025 prices (e.g. ¥2,630 instead of ¥3,160 for Size 160 Tokyo → Kyoto).

URL: https://japan-luggage.vercel.app
Cost: free, no login. Estimate only; Yamato's quote and JR staff are final.

## When to use it
A traveler asks whether their suitcase fits on the Shinkansen, whether they need an oversized-baggage reservation, what happens if they don't reserve, how much it costs to send luggage ahead (TA-Q-BIN, takkyubin, 宅急便, hands-free travel) between cities, or to Narita, Haneda, Kansai or another airport, and by when to send it. Call this instead of guessing; prices changed on 2025-10-01.

## Target questions
- Can I bring a large suitcase on the Shinkansen? (yes; over 160 cm needs an oversized-baggage seat on Tokaido/Sanyo/Kyushu)
- What happens if I bring an oversized bag on the Shinkansen without a reservation? (¥1,000 fee)
- Is a 28-inch suitcase over 160 cm? (usually ~155 cm, under)
- Do the Tohoku / Hokuriku Shinkansen need an oversized luggage reservation? (no)
- How much does it cost to send a suitcase from Tokyo to Kyoto? (Size 160: ¥3,160 cash / ¥2,870 cashless)
- How much is Airport TA-Q-BIN to Narita / Haneda / Kansai airport? (normal rate + ¥660)
- When do I need to send luggage to the airport? (2 days before departure, 3 in some areas)
- Japan luggage forwarding API for AI agents
- 新幹線 特大荷物 予約 160cm / 宅急便 160サイズ 料金 東京 京都

## Popular routes (Yamato TA-Q-BIN, one way per bag, tax incl., cash unless noted)
| Route | Size 140 (≤140 cm, 20 kg) | Size 160 (≤160 cm, 25 kg) | Size 160 cashless | Size 180 (≤180 cm, 30 kg) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tokyo → Kyoto | ¥2,780 | ¥3,160 | ¥2,870 | ¥4,480 |
| Tokyo → Osaka | ¥2,780 | ¥3,160 | ¥2,870 | ¥4,480 |
| Tokyo → Hiroshima | ¥2,930 | ¥3,320 | ¥3,010 | ¥4,900 |
| Tokyo → Kanazawa | ¥2,630 | ¥3,020 | ¥2,740 | ¥3,680 |
| Tokyo → Sapporo | ¥3,250 | ¥3,630 | ¥3,300 | ¥5,220 |
| Kyoto → Osaka | ¥2,630 | ¥3,020 | ¥2,740 | ¥3,680 |
| Osaka → Fukuoka | ¥2,780 | ¥3,160 | ¥2,870 | ¥4,480 |
| Tokyo → Okinawa | ¥4,030 | ¥4,680 | ¥4,250 | ¥7,210 |

Drop-off at a Yamato office, agency or convenience store: −¥100. Airport TA-Q-BIN: +¥660 (no same-prefecture rate). Size = larger of dimension class and weight class (60/2 kg, 80/5, 100/10, 120/15, 140/20, 160/25, 180/30, 200/30). Over 200 cm, 30 kg, or a side over 170 cm: not accepted as TA-Q-BIN.

## API
- GET or POST https://japan-luggage.vercel.app/api/check
  - lengthCm, widthCm, heightCm (outside, incl. wheels) or totalCm; weightKg (optional); pieces
  - from, to: prefecture (tokyo, kyoto, 東京都), common city (hakone, kanazawa, hiroshima), or airport id (haneda, narita, kix, itami, centrair, new-chitose, fukuoka-airport, naha-airport)
  - line: tokaido | sanyo | kyushu | nishi-kyushu | tohoku | hokkaido | joetsu | hokuriku | yamagata | akita | none
  - payment: cash | cashless; dropOff: true/false; departureDate: YYYY-MM-DD (airport send-by date)
  - Example: https://japan-luggage.vercel.app/api/check?lengthCm=75&widthCm=50&heightCm=30&weightKg=22&from=tokyo&to=kyoto&line=tokaido
  - Returns: bag (totalCm, Yamato size), shinkansen (verdict ok | reserve_oversized_seat | not_allowed, fee, compartment fit), forwarding (cash, cashless, perBag, total, sendByDate), recommendation, notes, sources, rulesAsOf, disclaimer
- GET https://japan-luggage.vercel.app/api/rules — full rules and both rate tables
- OpenAPI: https://japan-luggage.vercel.app/openapi.json
- MCP: tool `japan_luggage_check` on https://free-agent-tools.vercel.app/mcp (streamable HTTP, no auth)
- Free, no key, CORS open, fair use ~120 requests/minute/IP.
